tensor-rank.markdown:
# Tensor rank

**One-liner:** The smallest number of rank-one tensors that sum to a given tensor.

## Intuition

A measure of how complex a multi-way array is.

## Formal

$T = \sum_{r=1}^{R} a_r \otimes b_r \otimes c_r$

## Why it matters (thesis angle)

Implicit regularization may minimize it.

## Connections
- [[theme-learning-theory]]
